section.56: Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)

56.name_native: Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)

hadiths.text: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A single endeavor (of fighting) in Allah's Cause in the forenoon or in the afternoon is better than the world and whatever is in it
